title: 2026 IAHR-APD Awards presented at the Incheon Congress
summary: The Distinguished Membership Award went to Prof. Yasuyuki Shimizu and Prof. Adrian Law Wing Keung; the Heritage Award to the Soyanggang Dam.
body:
The **Distinguished IAHR-APD Membership Award** for 2026 was conferred on two recipients at the Congress closing ceremony.

**Prof. Yasuyuki Shimizu** (Hokkaido University, Japan) is recognised for his contributions to computational river morphodynamics — the numerical modelling of sediment transport, bank erosion, braided-river dynamics and vegetation–flow interaction — and for his central role in the iRIC river-simulation platform, adopted internationally as an open-source tool for river analysis.

**Prof. Adrian Law Wing Keung** (National University of Singapore) is recognised for his work in environmental and coastal hydraulics and for sustained service to the international water community, including as Editor-in-Chief of the Journal of Hydro-environment Research and as chair of the joint IAHR/IWA Committee on Marine Outfall Systems.

The **Water Conservancy and Environmental Heritage Award** was conferred on the **Soyanggang Dam**, received on behalf of K-water by Mr Yu In-Seon.

The **Best Paper Award** went to Bomi Kim (Kumoh National Institute of Technology), Akihiko Nakayama (Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman), Sujin Kim (The Seoul Institute) and Yushuang Sun (Yangzhou University). Full citations are listed under [Awards](/awards/).
